Tentang pekerjaan ini

We are seeking an AI Engineer to design, build and maintain artificial intelligence systems that support the company's operations.

Responsibilities

  • Develop the company's AI strategy and roadmap, including prioritizing implementations by business impact.
  • Design the company's AI system architecture, including access control and data separation between business units.
  • Integrate AI with the company's systems and applications, such as ERP, messaging apps, email and internal documents.
  • Develop business process automation, including sales order creation, order monitoring and margin monitoring.
  • Plan and set up server infrastructure, including GPUs, to run AI models internally so that confidential data does not leave the company.
  • Build question-and-answer systems based on internal documents such as SOPs and meeting minutes.
  • Evaluate and select AI technologies, models and vendors, including managing operating costs.
  • Measure the effectiveness of each AI system in terms of time and cost savings.
  • Monitor, maintain and document all systems developed.
  • Provide training and support to employees in the use of AI systems.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Informatics Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in AI/Machine Learning or software engineering, including at least 3 years handling AI projects in operational use.
  • Comprehensive understanding of AI fundamentals, including machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, speech recognition and generative AI.
  • Experience selecting, adapting (fine-tuning) and evaluating different types of AI models, both commercial and open-source.
  • Experience running AI models on internal servers and cloud services, including specifying the hardware required.
  • Ability to learn and integrate new software and systems quickly through APIs.
  • Proven experience designing and leading system development from design through to production.
  • Proficiency in programming languages commonly used for AI (such as Python), databases and server administration.
  • Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and the ability to read technical documentation in English.
  • Willing to work in Surabaya.

Preferred

  • Experience integrating ERP systems and business applications.
  • Experience in MLOps, such as model deployment, monitoring and versioning.
  • Publications, certifications or open-source contributions in AI.
  • Background in distribution, manufacturing or F&B companies.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • BPJS Health and BPJS Employment insurance
  • Religious holiday allowance (THR)
  • Work equipment and training support

How to Apply

Please submit your CV together with a portfolio or examples of AI projects you have worked on. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and a case study.
